free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: Tensor shape only; the guard at the target reads head_dim, not the number of heads.

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: GQA group size does not affect the head_dim set-membership guard.

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU-only run; float32 keeps the post-target path deterministic on CPU.

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: Sparse-attention coverage ratio consumed only below the target line.

free_parameters.name: tau
free_parameters.why: Query-aware head threshold consumed only below the target line.

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: Default; also allowed by the next guard, so it cannot mask the head_dim rejection.

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixed RNG seed for reproducible CPU inputs across fresh processes.
